# Orla Infinity

> ORLA Infinity is a low-rise, ultra-luxury residence on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah, set on a 16,600 square metre beachfront plot. Twelve storeys hold just 20 four-bedroom duplexes with private lift access, double-height living spaces, private gardens and terrace pools, alongside a standalone mansion. Residents share a beach club, spa, cinema and bowling alley, with services managed by Dorchester Collection.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Palm Jumeirah, Dubai, UAE
- Status: On-Going
- Year: 2027

## MENASCO Scope

ORLA Infinity is an exclusive collection of 20 four-bedroom duplex residences by OMNIYAT on Palm Jumeirah, designed by Foster + Partners with interiors by YODEZEEN and managed by Dorchester Collection. MENASCO is responsible for the complete MEP works, covering HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting, together with shell-and-core and high-end fit-out activities, incorporating smart-home capabilities and marine-grade solutions for the coastal environment.
